items.title: Whole-table CSV export lets staff walk away with every customer's personal data
One oversized or malformed file stalls the nightly import for everyone
Spreadsheet formula smuggled through import and run when marketing opens the export
Untrusted CSV fields built into database statements allow SQL injection
Uploader can overwrite or corrupt existing customer records by supplying ids in the CSV
Summary email carries customer personal data to an address taken from the upload
No way to tell who changed a customer record or to undo a bad import
